    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:32.420
    | text      = And then here are all the tools that the constitution and propaganda and all this stuff
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:36.420
    | text      = has to enforce a executive government that I do like.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:41.299

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:48.339
    | text      = that is Alex.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:49.220
    | text      = You know, not like, you were cool, man.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:51.619
    | text      = I was never cool.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:53.380
    | text      = Not once.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:54.579
    | text      = I was lying to you, you idiots.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:56.980
    | text      = Yeah, yeah, yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:58.099
    | text      = There's a...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:01.299
    | text      = It's a flawed criticism.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:03.619
    | text      = And then even if you take it at its most generous, it's a misarticulated criticism.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:10.099
    | text      = But these people are responding to something that is real.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:13.140
    | text      = Exactly.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:13.539
    | text      = And that is that Alex's tune has changed.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:16.259
    | text      = And he doesn't like that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:17.700
    | text      = He doesn't like the idea that like, oh, yeah, in order to maintain the position that I have
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:23.059
    | text      = now and the relationship with power that I have now, I have to give up on what is my
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:29.460
    | text      = stated philosophy and what I pretended to believe all this time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:32.819
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:33.859
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:34.099
    | text      = And I think that you're right that the real criticism is you were a liar.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:39.779
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:40.019
    | text      = You weren't, you didn't believe any of this shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:42.579
    | text      = It was just what was convenient for you at the time because you knew that there was no
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:46.579
    | text      = chance of executive power being something that would go in your direction.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:51.859
    | text      = Right, right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:52.819
    | text      = And you've internalized this criticism as being so bad, not because of the content of
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:58.900
    | text      = it, but because you've been lying to yourself as well.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:01.940
    | text      = Probably.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:02.420
    | text      = You've been trying to tell yourself you are also still the powerful truth teller while
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = at the same time being the bootlicking toady.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:09.700
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:10.099
    | text      = And I think that the criticism and the fact that it's happening on Twitter, where he is
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:18.980

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:25.059
    | text      = facade of the character that he is.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:28.579

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:31.220
    | text      = You know what's great about social media is that if you're somebody with a propensity
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = for repetitive thoughts, you want to have those externalized and then shot at you through

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = a gun.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:41.299

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:42.019

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:44.900
    | text      = So anyway, people are a little too mean to Alex on social media.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:47.779
    | text      = And I think he gets lost ranting about it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:51.460
    | text      = The Patriot is a scarce man.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:55.700
    | text      = Hated, feared, scorned.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:00.900
    | text      = But in time, when his cause succeeds, the timid join him because then it cost nothing
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:14.579
    | text      = to be a patriot.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:17.140
    | text      = When his cause succeeds, when his cause succeeds, when his cause succeeds, the timid join him
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:29.220
    | text      = then because it costs nothing to be a patriot.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:33.460
    | text      = And what did the timid and the Johnny-come-latelys do now that we're winning?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:39.539
    | text      = Oh, he sold out to the government.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:42.980
    | text      = He's with the system now.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:47.779
    | text      = We have not taken the government back yet, but we've taken large pieces over it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:53.380
    | text      = We've turned the tide and humans are not God.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:56.980
    | text      = And so we will always have problems.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:58.579
    | text      = And I'm not promising some utopia here.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:02.500
    | text      = What I'm saying is we're going back to the American system and we're going to have victory
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:09.140
    | text      = or we're going to have death.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:13.299
    | text      = As Colonel Travis wrote in his final letter to my ancestors in Gonzales, with instructions
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:29.539
    | text      = to take care of his son.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:31.859
    | text      = And that's what this is, ladies and gentlemen.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:36.420
    | text      = This is about victory or this is about death.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:42.900
    | text      = And we're going to get plenty of death if these people continue on, as you've seen with
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:46.660
    | text      = the poison shots, the GMO, the chemtrails, the fentanyl and all the autism and all this
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:58.019
    | text      = Mixing metaphors there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:00.099
    | text      = So my answer to the tyrants is victory or death.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:07.539
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:09.779
    | text      = Was that policy wise?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:12.740
    | text      = Like progressive taxes?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:14.339
    | text      = Victory or death with three lines under it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:17.539
    | text      = All right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:18.099
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:19.299
    | text      = Three lines.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:19.700
    | text      = Total commitment.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:21.700
    | text      = And when you commit to something worthy and good, it is not a weight.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:26.819
    | text      = It is everything.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:28.339
    | text      = It is your greatest strength.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:31.779
    | text      = It becomes your soul.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:34.259
    | text      = Keep in mind, this is a guy who's just mad about some things people said on Twitter.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:38.500
    | text      = Like he's God's appointed soldier to kill the devil.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:41.140
    | text      = But he also has to spend long chunks of time on air whining about how people don't respect
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:44.980
    | text      = him enough.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:46.339
    | text      = Also, I was thinking about that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:47.460
    | text      = Like, I'm not promising a utopia thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:49.859
    | text      = And that's sometimes not true.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:52.500
    | text      = Alex does get into utopian visions periodically, but I'm going to pretend that he doesn't.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:57.220
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:57.619
    | text      = If you just accept his premise that he doesn't promise the listeners a utopia, I still think
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:02.980
    | text      = that he sells his shit by promising utopia.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:05.220
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:05.940
    | text      = One version of utopia is the creation of an ideal state, but another is the avoidance
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:10.740
    | text      = of a totally evil one.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:12.660
    | text      = Alex doesn't promise a positive vision of a utopia, but he does promise the audience
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:17.220
    | text      = that if he wins, they'll be spared from the dystopia that he spends so much time on air
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:22.339
    | text      = describing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:23.460
    | text      = In effect, he's created a hell for them to fear and offered a path to salvation from
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:28.180
    | text      = it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:28.819
    | text      = This is really no different than promising someone a utopia if you follow them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:32.579
    | text      = It's just playing on their fear instead of optimism for a better tomorrow.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:36.259
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:36.420
    | text      = It's like, great.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:37.140
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:37.380
    | text      = You don't promise a utopia.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:38.819
    | text      = You promise...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:40.019
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:40.339
    | text      = Avoiding hell.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:41.299
    | text      = Ultimately, in both cases, all you're really promising is safety from pain.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:48.019
    | text      = One is a positive vision and the other is an absence of a negative one.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:52.180
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:52.579
    | text      = Great.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:53.059
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:53.539
    | text      = Cool, man.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:53.619
    | text      = Ultimately, fun to stumble upon them being fundamentally the same.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:00.259
    | text      = That's an interesting thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:01.779
    | text      = That's fun to get to.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:03.619
    | text      = But ultimately, yeah, no.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:05.059
    | text      = He doesn't understand anything.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:06.500
    | text      = No.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:06.819
    | text      = But, you know, Twitter gets to him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:10.019
    | text      = That sucks.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:11.619
    | text      = Yeah, it does.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:13.460
    | text      = That sucks.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:14.339
    | text      = It does.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:16.819
    | text      = I don't empathize or I don't feel for him, but of all the things that I would want to
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:23.940
    | text      = be tortured by, I really think social media, being addicted to it, and at the same time
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:31.059
    | text      = being...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:32.500
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:34.099
    | text      = Being a person who talks to the TV because the TV keeps calling me a piece of shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:39.779
    | text      = But also the TV keeps calling me a piece of shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:43.059
    | text      = You know, like it's really calling me a piece of shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:46.019
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:46.500
    | text      = That's terrifying.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:47.539
    | text      = It is.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:48.740
    | text      = And the fact that Alex has worked himself into this situation where in order for this
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:53.299
    | text      = business model to continue working, he has to keep getting called a piece of shit by
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:57.859
    | text      = the TV.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:58.420
    | text      = Yeah, it is a Twilight Zone episode.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:00.740
    | text      = It is fucked up to exist in his world.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:04.259
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:05.220
    | text      = So we get back to the news that's not Twitter based and has to do with the prescription
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:11.700
    | text      = drugs that Trump has...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:14.660
    | text      = He's just solved it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:16.180
    | text      = Oh, well, that's nice.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:17.140
    | text      = Humanity has awoken.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:21.539
    | text      = And it's getting more intense every day.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:24.019
    | text      = The level of the awakening is getting stronger.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:26.500
    | text      = So let's get into the big developments.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:30.259
    | text      = You know, on average, the people of the United States pay triple
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:34.259
    | text      = what anybody else pays on average for drugs.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:37.299
    | text      = Roughly double what people pay in Europe for the very same companies.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:42.180
    | text      = And that's because everything's been set up to screw the American consumer.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:46.660
    | text      = He just cut with an executive order, take a few months to phase in the cost of prescription
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:53.059
    | text      = drugs.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:54.099
    | text      = So the reason that prescription drug prices are lower in other countries is because other
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:57.940
    | text      = countries have regulations in place that limit those prices.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:00.900
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:02.420
    | text      = Places like England have nationalized health care that drives down the prices.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:06.420
    | text      = And essentially, those countries don't allow pharmaceutical companies to set their own
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:11.140
    | text      = prices and run the game however they want.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:13.299
    | text      = That seems crazy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:14.180
    | text      = On the flip side, the US doesn't have these types of protections for the consumers.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:18.579
    | text      = And big pharma and insurance companies can fleece us from medications at huge markups.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:23.779
    | text      = Trump signed an executive order that said that they were going to ask drug companies
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:27.380
    | text      = to voluntarily drop the prices of drugs, but there's no mechanism for enforcing anything,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:32.579
    | text      = and this will do jack shit to solve the problem that Americans face with health care.
